# Independent evaluation

[Back to README](../README.md) · [Bank status](bank.md#evaluation-status) · [Bank maintenance](bank-maintenance.md#evaluate-the-bundled-banks)

Each bundled bank is scored on every stored run it was not built from, with the production engine and no provider requests. Corpora are named by the first 12 characters of their SHA-256. Candidates are the enrolled models the engine cannot rule out; "Listed" counts runs or probes whose candidates include the tested model, and "Several vendors" those whose candidates span more than one model family.

## Claims

How often the default bank accepts a claimed model, meaning the claimed model is among a run's candidates, from `src/data/claim_rates.json`. The CLI and the library attach these figures to a claim checked with the bundled default bank. Own runs are the claimed model's runs from other collections; a model without any is measured on its tuning runs, which set its distance envelope, so that figure is optimistic. Other enrolled models' runs include their tuning runs, never their training runs, and are scored with the full bank. Models outside the bank are the models it does not enroll, and enrolled models scored with their own reference removed. "Most often accepted" lists other models whose runs pass as the claim in at least half of them. Ranges are 95% Wilson score intervals. These are acceptance rates on stored runs, not probabilities that an endpoint serves the claimed model; a model whose runs pass as a claim produces similar integers, and nothing more is implied.
